# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Summary verdict: NO-OP on capability artifacts (no actionable signal)
All 10 val trajectories are IDENTICAL pure-infrastructure failures: the sandbox never
built because the Docker base image could not be pulled — `dial tcp: lookup
registry-1.docker.io: i/o timeout` during `docker compose build` (`FROM ubuntu:24.04`).
Every rollout has `tool_calls=0`, `tokens=«redacted» `output=null`: the skills were never
invoked. There is therefore ZERO capability learning signal to diagnose against, and
every one of the 10 tasks is on the framework's explicit ignore list.

Shipping any skill-package edit would fail two of the three mandatory tests:
- REAL — no failing cluster with actionable content exists in `./trajectories/`.
- VERIFIED — nothing to verify a fix against (no tool calls, no outputs, no partial credit).
A speculative behavioral edit also carries pure downside: if the network recovers at
re-score, tasks that would otherwise pass could regress on an unverified change.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Sandbox build fails (Docker registry unreachable) | ALL 10 (offer-letter-generator, exceltable-in-ppt, xlsx-recover-data, sales-pivot-analysis, invoice-fraud-detection, weighted-gdp-calc, financial-modeling-qa, pdf-excel-diff, pptx-reference-formatting, reserves-at-risk-calc) | `registry-1.docker.io` DNS/connect i/o timeout at `docker compose build` → 100% fail during sandbox startup, skills never run | INFRA (uncontrollable) | none — not a capability defect |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| — | NONE | — | No edit passes REAL+VERIFIED given zero capability signal | n/a |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- No changes made. Confirmed via `python3` scan of all 10 trajectory JSONs: every one has
  `tool_calls=0`, `tokens=«redacted» and an `error` string containing the Docker registry i/o
  timeout — i.e. all are sandbox-build infra failures, none are capability failures.

## Process & features used
- Serial inspection only (read all 10 trajectories + cross-iteration files + skill package
  layout). No subagents/worktrees: there was no diagnosable failure to fan out over —
  the single "cluster" is uniform infra noise.
- Prior iterations read: none exist (this is the seed; LEDGER/RUNMAP/JOURNAL empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The seed skill packages (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx) are the valid baseline and are UNCHANGED.
  Do not make speculative edits to them without a real trajectory signal — the entire
  val split infra-errored, so no evidence exists about what would help or hurt.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- ALL 10 tasks — uniform Docker-registry-timeout infra noise; the tasks never ran the
  skills. No edit to any skill package can change a `docker compose build` network
  timeout, and the framework explicitly instructs not to change anything on their account.
